title: Revit Workset Purpose Governed Fields

entries.name: Workset identity
entries.requirement: Each governed production workset shall have a stable identity and name aligned with the applicable S4 naming structure.

entries.name: Workset purpose
entries.requirement: Each governed workset shall declare its purpose, such as datum/reference containment, linked-model containment, discipline/model scope, temporary working scope, or another approved project purpose.

entries.name: Allowed content
entries.requirement: Each governed workset purpose shall define or reference the element classes or content scope allowed on that workset.

entries.name: Prohibited content
entries.requirement: Where misuse would create coordination or maintenance risk, the governed workset purpose shall identify content that shall not be assigned to it.

entries.name: Default open or closed state
entries.requirement: Where model opening behavior is governed, the applicable default open or closed state shall be declared or referenced.

entries.name: Ownership scope
entries.requirement: Where a workset represents a team or model ownership boundary, the intended scope shall be declared without creating personal user ownership as a workset purpose.

entries.name: Linked-model scope
entries.requirement: Worksets used for linked models shall identify the applicable link scope or grouping basis so links can be placed and validated consistently.

entries.name: Temporary or working status
entries.requirement: Temporary, troubleshooting, import, or review worksets shall be explicitly identified as temporary and shall have a cleanup or closure expectation.

entries.name: Change control
entries.requirement: Creation, renaming, repurposing, or retirement of governed production worksets shall follow the project or standards change process rather than ad-hoc user preference.

non_promoted_source_content: No example source workset name such as Shared Levels and Grids, Links_Arch, Architecture_Main, Imports_Working, or similar is promoted as an enterprise-required literal name.
No enterprise-wide maximum workset count or fixed discipline/zone breakdown is invented from the source examples.

provenance.migration_note: Promotes the durable machine-readable fields needed to classify and validate workset purpose and containment while retaining source-era example names as noncanonical.
